content_sections.heading: FDDI Junior Faculty Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the FDDI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download FDDI Junior Faculty Job 2026 Notification PDF

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.fddiindia.com. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the FDDI Junior Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the FDDI Junior Faculty position is 28th September 2026. Candidates are advised to ensure their applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s Degree in Retail and fashion merchandise or General management with a minimum of 55% marks from a recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Faculty position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Faculty post will receive a salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Junior Faculty post?
faq.answer: The age limit for General category candidates is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for OBC (38 years), SC/ST (40 years), and PWD (45 years).

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Faculty post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Faculty post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the FDDI Junior Faculty recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Faculty position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Faculty position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Footwear Design and Development Institute (FDDI).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the FDDI located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the FDDI Guna campus, located in Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 480001.
